confidence_notes: Delft's city price index provides recent typical meal, cappuccino, and draft-beer prices. Local bar menus help bound wine and cocktail prices, estimated in relation to beer. Accommodation is a holistic, season-sensitive estimate based on general knowledge of Dutch tourist cities; no live accommodation prices were checked.
comparable_city_reasoning: Food and drink use Delft's own city-level price data. Accommodation reflects general knowledge of smaller Dutch cities with Delft's university and tourist demand, near Rotterdam and The Hague.
